stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It is categorized under key ML/AI tags including 'transformers', 'llama', and 'text-generation'.
This indicates active community interest and benchmarking activity around a significant LLM model.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and is optimized via Ollama's MLX engine with new DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Meta has unveiled Muse Spark, claiming it is a highly capable, open-weight US AI model.
The collaboration enables Muse AI models to run locally on Apple hardware, specifically the M5 Ultra Mac Studio.
The implementation leverages Apple's MLX framework, signaling a push for on-device, powerful AI inference.

stories.title: Volvo will use Nvidia’s tech for hands-free, point-to-point driving
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Volvo is integrating Nvidia's AI stack to develop a new hands-free, point-to-point driving system.
The company aims to launch this partially automated system by the year 2030.
The technology is classified as Level 2++, positioning it as an advanced, supervised automation feature.

stories.title: Report: FTC probes Anthropic, OpenAI after Trump dismissed AI fears as “hoax”
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: The FTC is reportedly investigating major AI developers, including Anthropic and OpenAI.
The investigation suggests the FTC may impose fines on these AI firms for issues similar to those faced by companies delaying data breach reports.
The probe follows a public dismissal of AI risks by former President Trump.

stories.title: Muse Spark Open
stories.author: bigwheels
bullet_points: Meta has released 'Muse Spark Open,' indicating a significant push toward open-sourcing advanced AI models.
The availability on Hugging Face suggests the model is intended for broader community access and experimentation.
This launch represents a major development in the competitive landscape of large language models (LLMs).

stories.title: AdFection: Targeted ads turned into a pipeline for zero-click mercenary spyware
stories.author: jcomp
bullet_points: A new threat, AdFection, weaponizes targeted advertising to deploy zero-click mercenary spyware.
The attack vector involves using digital advertising infrastructure, potentially originating from an Israeli firm, to compromise devices.
This represents a significant evolution in cyber threats, turning legitimate ad pipelines into sophisticated espionage tools.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational tasks.
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The tags confirm its relevance within the transformer and Llama ecosystem.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30-billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed to run locally, supporting continuous context gathering and tool use for multi-step tasks.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) leveraging MLX.
Speedup reaches up to 90% when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: Google is making inline links more prominent in AI responses
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Google is enhancing its AI search results (AI Overviews/AI Mode) by increasing the prominence of inline links.
This change aims to improve the visibility of source material within the customized AI response format.
The update is being introduced despite existing concerns that the AI summary format inherently reduces traditional link visibility.

stories.title: Friends don’t let friends feed their data to AI agents
stories.author: Janus Rose
bullet_points: Consumer tech is trending towards pervasive surveillance via gadgets.
New AI personal assistants, like Meta's Muse, are raising privacy concerns.
The trend suggests users may be pressured to share data not just about themselves, but about others.

stories.title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
stories.author: Cees G. M. Snoek
bullet_points: Addresses the rigidity of fixed-size transformer models (S, B, L) when facing fluctuating workloads.
Introduces a novel, retraining-free method to 'elastify' pre-trained transformers.
Allows a single model to dynamically adapt across a continuum of computational budgets on-the-fly.

stories.title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
stories.author: Cees G. M. Snoek
bullet_points: Addresses the rigidity of current transformer models, which are limited to fixed sizes (S, B, L).
Introduces a novel, retraining-free method to make pre-trained transformers 'elastic'.
Allows a single model to dynamically adapt its computational requirements across a continuum of hardware and workloads.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the deployment of AI agents using its cloud models.
The integration allows for running these AI agents securely within Fly.io's cloud infrastructure.
This combination addresses the need for safe and scalable deployment of AI agents in the cloud.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free decision-making based on text input.
The models can provide probabilistic answers to yes/no questions, choices, and scoring.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-weights model ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings improved performance and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware setups.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving support on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Bluesky's Attie AI tool has expanded its functionality beyond feed generation.
Users can now leverage Attie AI to create small, shareable social applications like games and polls.
These custom creations can be shared with others as if they were standalone websites on the platform.

stories.title: E Ink upgraded the screen found in most color e-readers
stories.author: Andrew Liszewski
bullet_points: E Ink has announced Kaleido 4, the next generation of its color e-paper screen technology.
The new technology aims to improve upon the existing Kaleido 3 displays used in various e-readers and tablets.
The update is relevant to the niche market of e-readers, impacting devices from Kobo, PocketBook, and Boox.

stories.title: Black Sea drone attacks enter NATO country's territorial waters for first time
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Suspected Russian drones have entered the territorial waters of a NATO country (Romania).
The attacks targeted a chemical tanker within Romanian waters.
This marks the first reported instance of such drone incursions into the country's waters.

stories.title: Singer or clanker? YouTube Music will tell you with new gen AI labeling.
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: YouTube Music is implementing new generative AI labeling features.
This AI labeling technology is also slated for rollout on the main YouTube platform.
The feature aims to categorize music, suggesting a shift in how users interact with music discovery.

stories.title: Fridge hack costing millions and sparking fires stemmed from poor security
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: A security vulnerability in supermarket refrigeration units led to a major incident.
The hack exploited outdated devices that were connected to the internet.
The incident resulted in significant costs and caused fires across 700 supermarkets.

stories.title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
stories.author: Koushil Sreenath
bullet_points: The research addresses a gap in humanoid control by focusing on modeling the distribution of learned neural network weights, rather than just training the networks conventionally.
The work investigates the feasibility of generating high-performing humanoid control networks directly within the weight space using diffusion models.
This advances the field of robot learning by providing a new methodology for understanding and synthesizing complex control policies.

stories.title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of real-world fine-tuning in Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) due to high-dimensional action spaces.
Proposes HiRe-MoMa, a Hierarchical Residual Mobile Manipulation framework for stable and sample-efficient fine-tuning.
Utilizes a Hierarchical Residual Architecture to improve the learning process for complex MoMa systems.

stories.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
stories.author: Jiaxuan You
bullet_points: Addresses the computational bottleneck in training language agents caused by expensive long-horizon rollouts.
Proposes a novel approach, 'Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting,' to better utilize intermediate step supervision in Reinforcement Learning (RL).
Identifies limitations in prior work, specifically the difficulty in constructing effective per-step value or observation targets from a single terminal scalar reward.

stories.title: Continuum Attention
stories.author: Afshin Khadangi
bullet_points: Introduces Continuum Attention (CA), a novel causal Transformer attention operator.
Replaces discrete key/value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve.
Enables exact normalized attention calculation from closed-form exponential moments, simplifying gradient computation.

stories.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
stories.author: Hwee Tou Ng
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of training AI agents to master complex, visually rich video games.
Current methods are limited by reliance on large demonstrations and difficulty in creating scalable training environments.
The paper introduces 'Player-1' to advance general digital control capabilities beyond simple screen interaction.

stories.title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
stories.author: Peng Qi
bullet_points: LLM agents suffer from interface binding, meaning their performance degrades when the input interface is slightly changed from the training setup.
The research proposes 'Cross-Interface Consistency Training' to improve the robustness of LLM agents against interface variations.
The method aims to decouple the LLM's core competence from the specific interface it was trained on, enhancing out-of-distribution performance.

stories.title: Beyond LLM Judge: Mechanical Verification for Agentic Autoformalization
stories.author: Michael R. Douglas
bullet_points: Introduces a novel verification method for Lean formalizations that moves beyond reliance solely on LLM judgment.
The method integrates LLM-based semantic review with rigorous mechanical numerical and vacuity checks for enhanced accuracy.
The research applies this technique within an Extract-Verify-Proof pipeline to construct the Formalized Library of Mathematical Functions (FLMF).

stories.title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
stories.author: Taylor W. Killian
bullet_points: The paper addresses a limitation in On-Policy Distillation (OPD), where the teacher's ability to guide the student fails on incorrect sequences.
It introduces CriticOPD, a novel method that uses a critic to recognize and correct errors in the student's rollouts.
This technique aims to restore the 'recoverability' property of the teacher model, improving the training robustness of distillation processes.

stories.title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
stories.author: Koushil Sreenath
bullet_points: The research focuses on modeling and understanding the neural weights of humanoid control policies.
It addresses a gap in current robot learning by moving beyond conventional training to model weight distributions.
The study investigates using diffusion models to generate functional humanoid control networks directly in weight space.

stories.title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of real-world fine-tuning in Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) systems.
Introduces HiRe-MoMa, a framework utilizing a Hierarchical Residual Architecture for stable and sample-efficient tuning.
Focuses on handling high-dimensional action spaces and complex module coupling in autonomous robotics.

stories.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
stories.author: Jiaxuan You
bullet_points: The research addresses the computational bottleneck in training language agents caused by expensive long-horizon rollouts.
It critiques existing methods in agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) that fail to effectively utilize intermediate-step supervision.
The proposed work introduces a novel approach, 'Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting,' to better leverage per-step information beyond terminal rewards.

stories.title: Continuum Attention
stories.author: Afshin Khadangi
bullet_points: Introduces Continuum Attention (CA), a novel causal Transformer attention operator.
Replaces discrete key/value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve.
Allows for exact normalized attention calculation via closed-form exponential moments, simplifying gradient computation.

stories.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
stories.author: Xu Han
bullet_points: Addresses the memory and computational bottleneck caused by large Key-Value (KV) caches in long-context LLMs.
Introduces 'Latent Compaction,' a method that learns a compact, document-specific cache via test-time training.
Uses initialization techniques based on reconstruction importance, teacher attention, and key-space diversity to maintain information fidelity.

stories.title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
stories.author: Peng Qi
bullet_points: LLM agents exhibit brittleness, tying their competence to the specific interface they were trained on.
Minor, semantics-preserving changes to the interface (e.g., renaming actions) degrade agent performance.
The proposed 'Cross-Interface Consistency Training' aims to improve LLM agent robustness against interface variations.

stories.title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
stories.author: Taylor W. Killian
bullet_points: The paper addresses a limitation in On-Policy Distillation (OPD) where teacher models fail to provide reliable supervision on incorrect student rollouts.
The core problem identified is the 'recoverability of the teacher,' which breaks down when the student makes errors.
The proposed solution, CriticOPD, introduces a critic mechanism to allow the teacher to critique incorrect rollouts, thereby restoring supervision reliability.

stories.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
stories.author: Xu Han
bullet_points: Addresses the memory and computational bottleneck of long context processing in LLMs due to large KV caches.
Proposes 'Latent Compaction,' a method that learns a compact, document-specific cache using test-time training.
Initializes cache entries using metrics like reconstruction importance, teacher attention, and key-space diversity.

stories.title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
stories.author: Peng Qi
bullet_points: LLM agents exhibit interface dependency, meaning their performance degrades when the input interface is slightly altered from the training environment.
The paper proposes 'Cross-Interface Consistency Training' to improve LLM agent robustness against interface variations.
This method aims to decouple the agent's core task competence from the specific interface it was trained on, improving out-of-distribution generalization.

stories.title: Manacá-1B-Instruct-2: Reproducible Safety Alignment for a Native Brazilian-Portuguese LLM. Negative DPO Results, a Controlled Composition Scan, and a Silent Failure Mode of the LLM Judge
stories.author: Fabio André Machado Porto
bullet_points: Introduces Manacá-1B-Instruct-2, a new, safety-aligned LLM specifically for Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR).
Highlights rigorous methodology by documenting multiple negative Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) attempts and controlled composition scans.
Addresses a gap in the field by providing detailed documentation on alignment failures and the limitations of LLM judges.

stories.title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting
stories.author: Matei Zaharia
bullet_points: LLM agents show promise in automated research by iteratively discovering new ideas.
Scaling automated research (longer iteration, parallel agents, communication) eventually leads to plateaus.
The paper suggests that 'forgetting' is necessary to overcome the limitations of accumulating history in LLM agents.

stories.title: PerSo: Investigating Facets of LLMs' Social Intelligence in Real-World Persuasion Scenarios
stories.author: Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh
bullet_points: The research investigates the 'social intelligence' of Large Language Models (LLMs) using real-world persuasion scenarios.
Social intelligence is broken down into cognitive intelligence (inferring mental states) and behavioral intelligence (selecting appropriate social actions).
Persuasion serves as a natural and complex testbed to evaluate both cognitive and behavioral aspects of LLM social capabilities.

stories.title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
stories.author: Jiahui Gao
bullet_points: The research introduces 'PrismaCoder,' focusing on open multimodal code intelligence.
Multimodal code intelligence bridges the gap between program code (symbolic) and its visual output.
The work aims to advance open-source capabilities in generating complex artifacts (charts, web pages) compared to closed proprietary models.

stories.title: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
stories.author: Chuan-Wei Kuo
bullet_points: ReaDy introduces a new speculative decoding method for LLMs.
It leverages Hybrid Linear Attention (HLA) models to maintain compact recurrent states for context.
This approach addresses limitations in feature-based drafters by providing complementary historical context for drafting.

stories.title: Lost in Translation: Why Lower Bias Scores Don't Mean Fairer Models
stories.author: Harsh Kumar
bullet_points: The study questions the validity of current bias auditing methods in multilingual NLP, which often rely on comparing average stereotype scores across languages.
Researchers investigate how much of the observed language-based score differences might be statistical noise rather than genuine fairness issues.
The methodology involves testing model sensitivity to rephrasing (English test items) and injecting targeted shifts across eight languages.

stories.title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
stories.author: Daling Wang
bullet_points: Addresses a critical limitation in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models: failure during long-horizon, unseen tasks.
Proposes 'AdaRSI,' a method for on-demand Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) in embodied agents.
Distinguishes between failures due to execution errors versus limitations in the executor's capabilities, guiding when model weights should be updated.
